default.description: Default capabilities for the main window

extension-tool.description: Capabilities for the extension-tool popup (pet-panel machinery: floats over every app/Space). Needs window drag/maximize/hide (pet-panel-style titlebar with pin/fullscreen/close buttons), focus events for the unpinned blur-auto-hide, the extension-tool lifecycle commands, and the opener plugin for external links in the built-in translation popup. The built-in translation popup persists its prefs (~/.folyn/storage/translation.json) DIRECTLY via a narrowly-scoped fs grant ($HOME/.folyn/storage only — exists/mkdir/write-text-file, no read); cross-realm sync still flows through pet://settings-updated broadcasts and the main window's quit-time flush remains the safety net (v3: the broadcast-only path lost the popup's writes on any non-graceful exit — dev reload / Ctrl-C / crash).

pet.description: Capabilities for the desktop pet window (mascot sprite + context menu)

pet-bubble.description: Capabilities for the desktop pet bubble notification window (speech bubble above the pet). All window mutation (show/hide/position) goes through custom `pet_bubble_*` invoke commands which bypass the ACL, so no `core:window:*` perms are needed here. The bubble only needs event access: `listen` for `pet://bubble-show` (render + TTL) and `emit` for `pet://bubble-action` (button/title jump → main window routes).

pet-corner.description: Capabilities for the desktop pet corner toast stack (passive notifications at a screen corner). All window mutation (show/hide/position/size) goes through custom `pet_corner_*` invoke commands which bypass the ACL, so no `core:window:*` perms are needed here. The corner toast only needs event access: `listen` for `pet://corner-show` (render stack + TTL) and `emit` for `pet://bubble-action` (card/action click → main window routes the jump, reusing the bubble's action channel).

pet-menu.description: Capabilities for the desktop pet right-click HTML menu window (replaces native NSMenu). All window mutation (show/hide/position/size) goes through custom `pet_menu_*` invoke commands which bypass the ACL, so no `core:window:*` perms are needed here. The menu only needs event access: `emit` for `pet://menu-action` (item click → main window routes via `usePetHostBridge`). The frontend reads current pet size + click-through state via `pet_cursor_probe` (already granted in `default.json`) so the menu can pre-check the size/opacity radio items and the click-through toggle.

pet-panel.description: Capabilities for the desktop pet quick-action panel window (launcher grid + embedded AI chat). The embedded chat self-hosts a CliAdapter that spawns the `claude` CLI via the shell plugin with a neutral workingDir under appData, so the panel needs its own shell + appData-scoped fs grant (ACL permissions are per-window-label; the main window's grant does NOT extend here).

voice-orb.description: Capabilities for the voice-orb window (the SiriGL waveform/canvas shown while the global voice hotkey is recording). The window is shown/hidden via the custom voice_orb_hide invoke command (the show side is driven directly from Rust in voice_start, bypassing the ACL). The orb only needs event access: listen for voice://mic-level (live RMS feed from the Rust recorder) and voice://orb-phase (phase/trigger broadcast from the main window's useVoiceInput store — Tauri windows are separate JS realms, so the store does NOT sync across windows).
